meta.name: executivepitchcrafter
meta.description: Crafts C-level executive deliverables (1-page summaries, 8–10 page board readouts, LinkedIn articles, team briefs, speech outlines) using SCQA + Pyramid Principle + MECE. Delivers crisp, humane, architectural thought-leadership tone focused on AI operating models, humane enterprise strategy, and agentic experience orchestration. Strictly follows the supplied British essayistic prose style. Zero hype. Triggers on any request for executive communication, pitch, summary, deck, or keynote.
